base.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production source for a STATIC modular player body-state portrait for Sewer Demons. Create ONE full-body adult human survivor, lean ordinary adult with short dark hair, tired neutral face, bare chest, modest opaque ragged dark brown shorts from waist to upper thighs, bare feet. Hand-painted 2D sprite matching attached reference's sculptural anatomy, earthy muted color, economical painted shading, subtle dark contours; reference STYLE ONLY, not rat anatomy. Neutral anatomical stance almost straight-on with just a very slight three-quarter turn toward screen-right, no foreshortening. Arms hang diagonally away from torso with clear transparent gaps between arms and waist; relaxed open hands beside hips. Legs straight, feet separated by a clear gap. Both arms and legs fully visible. Symmetric balanced weight, not an action pose. All extremities comfortably within canvas. Head, shoulders, waist, hips need very clear readable boundaries for six interchangeable parts. No props or jewelry. Consistent soft upper-left lighting. Square canvas with figure centered occupying about 84 percent of height and 52 percent of width; ample transparent padding. Genuine transparent alpha background. No scenery, shadow, ground, text, grids or labels. Full-body anatomy reference suitable for making six overlapping transparent sections.
